text:
maya: deploy-bot quarantined the prod promotion for payments-service in eu-west — image digest drift detected after canary. @liam @ashley can you take a look? :thinking_face:

deploy-bot: Promotion ID prom-20260321-17 quarantined. Reason: image digest mismatch across regions.
- eu-west: sha256:af3c9b...
- us-west: sha256:b42e12...
Action: HOLD and require manual approval or values pin. Logs: /deploy/prom-20260321-17/logs

liam: pulling the diffs. do we have a helm values diff or just registry rewrite?

maya: I see a registry rebuild pushed the same tag (v2.4.1) with different digest in us-west. canary pods in eu show the eu digest. probably a multi-regional image sync issue.

ashley: change window closes in 22m. we need a decision: pin the production values to a specific digest and promote, or rollback the tag in chart to the previous stable digest and re-run canary. both require release notes update.

liam: quick check: `kubectl -n prod get pods -l app=payments -o wide` shows 3/3 ready in eu with old digest. no OOMs. metrics look fine. so pin is lower-risk.

maya: agree. plan: create a small values override PR that sets `image.digest: sha256:af3c9b...` for prod-eu and prod-global, run CI, then manual promote. I can open PR now.

ashley: if we pin, we should also add a short rollback playbook in the PR description. customers on eu will be unaffected, but we need to note the reason. I'll draft the release note.

release-lead: ack. prefer pin+promote, but include steps to revert to tag v2.4.0 (sha256:c8d7ff...) if anything degrades.

liam: PR template snippet to run:
```
helm upgrade payments ./charts/payments --namespace prod --set image.digest=sha256:af3c9b... --reuse-values --wait
```

maya: PR opened: https://git.redwood/payments/compare/pin-digest-prod-eu (CI started). tagging @release-lead for manual promote after CI ✅

deploy-bot: Note: manual promotion requires explicit `release-lead` approval or `sre` ack. Use `deploy-bot promote --id prom-20260321-17 --manual-ack <user>` to continue.

release-lead: approved. going to run promote after CI green.

sre-oncall: quick check on infra impact: no elevated error rates. pin looks fine. I'll monitor for 30m after promote.

maya: CI passed. running manual promote now.

deploy-bot: promotion prom-20260321-17 proceeding (manual ack by release-lead).

deploy-bot: Promotion complete. pods in prod-eu now running pinned digest sha256:af3c9b...; rollout 3/3 ready.

ashley: drafting release note: "Hotfix: pin payments-service image digest in prod to avoid cross-region tag rewrite. No user-facing changes." will post to release-notes channel.

liam: leaving follow-up issue to add an image replication validation to our CI to prevent tag rewrites across registries. created https://git.redwood/infra/issues/478

maya: thanks team. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
